continuity: The Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, the Emei Sect Leader and its sole Supreme Peak master, and three Emei Elders were killed on Mount Emei three days before this chapter by a one-armed middle-aged man.
Venerable Myoryeong survived the attack but suffers from the Black Hand Seal and requires urgent treatment before seven days have passed.
Mungyeong knows the Black Hand Seal and its progression because his Master taught him; Taekyung now suspects that Mungyeong's Master may be the Divine Physician.

The Qingcheng Sect has divided its available forces: one Elder is leading Disciples to aid Emei, the other is returning to the main sect, and Qingcheng will send someone to warn the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Tang Sadok is pursuing the culprit behind Tang Taesang's murder with members of the Tang Family while the Tang Clan remains partially absent from its base.
Jin Taekyung and his companions remain in Sichuan searching for the unidentified Divine Physician, while Jeok Cheongang remains critically ill and in need of treatment.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau's Young Bureau Head while investigating its traitors; Song Ilseom remains for one month to help her before seeking Ju Hogun's elixir in Xianyang.
plot: Venerable Myoryeong reported that the Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, the Emei Sect Leader and its sole Supreme Peak master, had been murdered along with three Elders by a one-armed middle-aged man. Taekyung connected this killer to the culprit behind Tang Taesang's murder, though the connection remained unconfirmed.

Taekyung carried the critically injured Myoryeong while the Qingcheng Elders divided their forces between aiding Emei and returning to their main sect, promising to warn the Sichuan Tang Clan. Myoryeong had survived the attack only long enough to identify the killer and seek help.

Mungyeong reunited with the group and treated Myoryeong, then diagnosed the injury as the evil technique Black Hand Seal and warned that it would become irreversible after seven days and lead to death within roughly a year. When questioned about his knowledge, he said his Master had taught him, prompting Taekyung to suspect that the Master might be the Divine Physician.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung and Cheongpung remain in Sichuan seeking the Divine Physician, with Hyuk Mujin and Gung Gibang supporting the search.
The government and Murim are conducting a joint search throughout Sichuan after Taekyung secured Won Gyun's cooperation with Prince Shangshan's Token.
The Divine Physician remains unidentified and unfound somewhere in Sichuan, while Mungyeong's Master may be connected to that identity.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious and steadily weakening, with at most roughly half a year remaining without treatment.
Tang Taesang was murdered, and Tang Sadok is pursuing the culprit with members of the Sichuan Tang Clan.
The Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun, the Emei Sect Leader, and three Emei Elders were killed on Mount Emei by a one-armed middle-aged man.
Venerable Myoryeong survived the Emei attack but has a severe Black Hand Seal injury requiring urgent treatment.
The Qingcheng Sect has divided its forces to aid Emei and protect its own main sect, and it is sending a warning to the Sichuan Tang Clan.
Mungyeong knows the Black Hand Seal because his Master taught him its nature and progression.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau's Young Bureau Head while investigating its traitors; Song Ilseom remains for one month to help her before seeking Ju Hogun's elixir in Xianyang.
open_questions: Who is the one-armed middle-aged killer, what is his purpose, and is he the same person behind Tang Taesang's murder?
Can Venerable Myoryeong survive the Black Hand Seal and receive effective treatment before its seven-day point?
Is Mungyeong's Master the Divine Physician, as Taekyung now suspects?
Can the Divine Physician be found and treat Jeok Cheongang before his remaining time expires?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will the Zhongnan Sect's leaders and wider organizers respond?
temporary_decisions: Render 경천신니 as Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun and 혈나찰 as Blood Rakshasa.
Render 흑수인 as Black Hand Seal and 사공 as evil technique in this medical context.
Render 입적 as passed into nirvana for the death of a Buddhist nun.
Render 악귀 as demon or demon incarnate according to whether it functions as a general description or a direct characterization.
